submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game sprite 04 mountain guardian boy, one standalone square transparent RGBA frame at least1024. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its whole-canvas layout, head and torso size/position, brown hair/green ribbons, gold-green armor/ivory pants, arms/hands and their exact grasp (anatomical right hand long gold staff, left forearm round shield), staff entire shaft/end, jade ring transparent hole. Image2 is SAME-DIRECTION GROUNDED STANCE geometry reference only, do not copy its whole pose. Image3 identity, image4 directional idle/camera, image5 approved painterly style. Redraw only specified lower limb anatomy and clothing folds into a fresh independent motion pose. No mirroring, tweening, collage, repeated image, whole character translation, camera change, ground/shadow/text/effects. Legs must have natural knee flex and weight, knee-ankle-toe aligned in direction of movement, no ankle rolling or sideways duck-foot.  Direction SW frame 14/16. SW front three-quarter direction toward lower-left. Anatomical LEFT leg is SCREEN-RIGHT/shield-side, preserve as the support leg from image2. RIGHT leg on screen-left keeps its original swing forward, NOT a planted leg. Redraw ONLY screen-right leg from its present lifted/tucked shoe to a weight-bearing grounded stance behind pelvis, knee and toe facing lower-left in travel plane, never toe sideways. Lower the support boot to ground, heel/forefoot visibly bears weight, no underside visible. Third position segment second frame: same left/shield-side sole bears weight a little behind hip, approximately x712,y930 on1024; knee gently extends. Keep right/screen-left swinging shoe extended forward in air as target.
